risks.note: Management states that "Single plant Regional Operators" renewed their aggression and expanded into newer geographies, and that this impacted realisation in fibre cement sheets even as volumes grew around 6%.
risks.risk: Price competition from single-plant regional operators eroding realisation

risks.note: Depreciation of the Rupee affected raw material cost during the year; the impact was only partially mitigated through consistent and judicious usage of raw materials and supplier negotiations. Sustainable supply chain is separately identified in the BRSR materiality table as a risk covering supply disruptions, raw material availability and cost volatility.
risks.risk: Raw material cost and currency exposure

risks.note: Volatility in cotton prices continues with wide fluctuations in both cotton and yarn; India's 2025-26 crop fell 4% to 313 lakh bales on lower acreage and world production for 2026-27 is expected to decrease by 5%. The Company relies on shifting to value-added customized yarn counts to offset falling demand for commodity counts.
risks.risk: Cotton and yarn price volatility with weak demand for commodity counts

risks.note: Early signs of Middle East war tension were felt in the last quarter and created dealer up-stocking, while prices of substitutes inched up in Q4 due to an ongoing shortage of fuel; the macro review also flags geopolitical tensions, trade fragmentation and policy uncertainty as global downside risks.
risks.risk: Geopolitical and fuel-supply disruption affecting demand phasing and substitutes

risks.note: Identified in the BRSR material issues table as a risk of workplace incidents in manufacturing operations, mitigated through strong EHS systems, training and compliance monitoring; the entity also commits to zero fatality targets and continuous reduction of LTIFR.
risks.risk: Workforce health and safety in manufacturing operations
